text:
isha: starting staggered deploy for billing-service v1.12.0 in change window 02:00-03:30 UTC. feature flag `billing_v1beta` will be enabled at 2% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100%. release: https://redwood.internal/releases/billing-v1.12 :rocket:

deploy-bot: /deploy canary billing-service v1.12.0 by @isha. canary nodes: 2 in us-west2. initial flag weight=2%

noah: set regional override for latam: max 10% until we validate payment flow. add auto-pin if 5xx > 0.7% or p99 > 700ms.

sre-bot: alert hooks attached. pausing criteria: p95 +40% OR payment errors delta > 0.4% absolute OR CPU > 80% on canaries.

leo: ramp plan OK. make sure to mute debug logs for partner cohorts: `partner_debug=false` under flags.

deploy-bot: metrics after 12m: 2% stable, rps 90, p95 85ms, 5xx 0.05%. promoting to 15% now. updating flag `billing_v1beta_weight: 2 -> 15`

(9m later)
sre-bot: latam p95 increased to 240ms but 5xx still <0.3%. no auto-pin trigger yet.

noah: reduce latam to 8% and enable deeper traces: `/ops/traces collect --run 6180000001`

(6m later)
sre-bot: latam 5xx rose to 0.75% -> auto-pin conditions met. initiating regional pin.
deploy-bot: executing `deploy-bot pin billing-service v1.11.9 --region latam --reason "auto-pin-5xx"` -> SUCCESS. latam back to v1.11.9.

isha: decision: keep latam pinned, continue ramp for others to 50% after 20m hold. open a follow-up EU/latam postmortem.

leo: added rollback snippet in runbook for quick global rollback if needed:
```
deploy-bot rollback billing-service --to v1.11.9 --scope global --reason "rollback-on-regression"
```

noah: noted. saving traces to /runs/6180000001/traces and creating EPIC for cache fallback in payments.

isha: thanks team. will post an update to #customer-success and close once we either unpin latam or finish full rollout. :white_check_mark:
